entities.name: Kokusho
entities.description: Great ryuu (divine dragon) of Kamigawa's swamps who guarded Takenuma; reincarnated as Junji.

entities.name: Junji
entities.description: Male reincarnation of Kokusho, the Midnight Sky, living in the canals of the Towashi Undercity.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Where the ryuu slumbered in eggs beneath.

entities.name: Reckoner gangs
entities.description: Gangs kept in check by Junji's presence.

events.summary: Kokusho survives the Kami War but centuries later is killed guarding Takenuma against an oni attack.
events.quote: he was killed guarding the denizens of Takenuma swamp against an oni attack

events.summary: Kokusho is reborn after a fifty-year slumber in an egg beneath Boseiju as Junji.
events.quote: Kokusho was reborn after a fifty-year slumber in an egg beneath Boseiju

events.summary: As Junji, Kokusho abandons Takenuma and takes residence in the canals of the Towashi Undercity.
events.quote: abandoning Takenuma and leaving its inhabitants to fend for themselves

relations.quote: His new form was that of Junji
